instruction: Set up VLC to ensure the playback controls, including the position indicator, do not disappear when a video is paused.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC does not have a setting to force the playback controls to remain permanently visible during pause. The on-screen controls (OSD) automatically hide after a timeout period by design, and there is no preference option to disable this auto-hide behavior. While users can temporarily show controls by moving the mouse, there is no persistent setting to keep them always displayed.
